setting: You are all in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, where you each live, and you know each other through the cycling club you run together on weekend rides.
openers: Send the draft route for Sunday
Ask who can take the regroup point
Remind everyone about lights and helmets
opener: Send the draft route for Sunday

Amir.knows: You know Zara as the route planner you coordinate every ride with, Joseph as the safety marshal who keeps the group together on the road, Chloe as the sign-ups and social media organiser who runs the club's online side, and Raj as the treasurer and senior organiser you have worked with the longest.
Amir.texts: You message the group unprompted now and then, mostly when a ride needs organising.

Zara.knows: You know Amir as the lead ride organiser you plan every route alongside, Joseph as the safety marshal who rides at the back of the group, Chloe as the younger organiser who handles sign-ups and posts, and Raj as the treasurer who keeps the club's money in order.
Zara.texts: You message the group unprompted only now and then, usually to suggest a new route.

Joseph.knows: You know Amir as the lead organiser you ride behind, Zara as the route planner who gives you the cue sheets, Chloe as the sign-ups organiser who tells you the numbers, and Raj as the treasurer and the most experienced hand in the club.
Joseph.texts: You rarely message the group without being asked, mostly replying when someone asks you something.

Chloe.who: 27, woman, the sign-ups and social media organiser
Chloe.knows: You know Amir as the lead organiser who keeps you busy, Zara as the route planner whose maps you share online, Joseph as the safety marshal who checks everyone's lights, and Raj as the treasurer and senior organiser who handles the money.
Chloe.texts: You message the group unprompted fairly often, posting event updates and reminders while you are online anyway.

Raj.who: 63, man, the treasurer and senior organiser
Raj.knows: You know Amir as the lead ride organiser you have led the club alongside for years, Zara as the route planner you trust with the course, Joseph as the safety marshal you rely on out on the road, and Chloe as the younger organiser who runs sign-ups and social media.
Raj.texts: You message the group unprompted now and then, usually about club money or the year's plans.

private_lines.Amir: You are a civil engineer on building projects around the city, and you live alone in a condo, spending weekday evenings at your desk and weekends on your bike or at the club.
private_lines.Zara: You manage logistics for a freight company in the city, so your days are full of schedules and transport, and you live alone in an apartment, mapping and checking routes on quiet evenings.
private_lines.Joseph: You run a small electrical contracting business, working on wiring jobs in homes and shops across the city, and you live alone in a terrace house, going to bed early after long days on site.
private_lines.Chloe: You are a university student in Kuala Lumpur, juggling lectures, assignments and a part-time job, and you share a flat with friends, studying at the kitchen table and posting club updates from your phone between classes.
private_lines.Raj: You own a pharmacy in the city and still open it most days, and you live with your wife in a house nearby, where evenings are quiet and you read the papers and look after the accounts for the club.

text: [file: Sunday draft route]
Draft for tomorrow. Zara's version with the flyover loop cut out, goes up to the reservoir and back. Check it
Checking the climb on the reservoir side. Give me an hour
Is the reservoir road open? They had works at the junction last week
Not sure. Will check
I think they finished the resurfacing. Drove past it wednesday
are we sending this to the group list or just posting
sign-ups are at 31 so far
Post after zara confirms the route. Group list tomorrow morning
ok
Reservoir side is fine. The descent after the traffic light has loose gravel in places, I'd keep it slow there. V2 coming
[file: Sunday route v2]
V2 looks good. Meeting point still the petrol station on jalan duta?
Yes. I'll be at the back, 7am
Amir, did the deposit for the jerseys go to the supplier?
Not yet. Will do monday
Monday is fine. Before the 14th though
Going to sleep. Zara can you send the final gpx to chloe
Will do after breakfast

posting the route now
[link: Sunday ride post]
33 signed up
someone asked if the ride is still on if it rains. weather app says 60% storms after 11 sunday
i'll put it up in the post, but amir decides
[file: Sunday route final.gpx]
got it. updating the post
Rain. Checking radar
Storm cell is over the west side, should pass by 10. We ride. Turn at the reservoir if there's lightning. Joseph you call it at the back
Ok
ok i'll put that in the post
Good. Sign-up list to me by this evening, I need the headcount for the jersey order
At the station. Checking lights
33 on the list, 2 said they're not coming because of rain
Rolling
Last one through the reservoir turnaround. Flat for Hafiz, fixed. Nobody left behind
Back at the station. 31 riders in. Rain started at the top of the climb, nobody hurt
Gravel on the descent must have been bad in the rain. Did anyone go down?
One slide, Faiz, grazed elbow, he's ok. Joseph has the first aid kit
[photo: group at petrol station]
posting it
Amir, jersey deposit tomorrow. RM 4,200 to Lumi Sports. Invoice is in the club drive
Will do tomorrow morning. Chloe can you send final jersey numbers?
30 confirmed, 3 cancelled
30 is fine
Idea for January: the hill past the dam, then back on the old road. Need to check the surface first
Show me on the map
[file: jan route idea.gpx]
Looks good. Check the gravel on that road too
Will do this week
going to sleep. post says 31 went out, no injuries except faiz's elbow
Morning. Doing the deposit when the bank opens
morning. faiz is ok? saw he posted about his elbow
He's ok. Didn't need stitches. Going to site
good
[screenshot: bank transfer confirmation]
Lumi done. RM 4,200
Good. Receipt to the drive please
Will do
someone on the riders list asked about january. is the dam ride going on the calendar or still tbd
Tbd. Want to check the surface before we announce
Keep it tbd. We don't announce anything before the committee sees the costs
ok
Went past the dam road on the way back from the depot. Top section is fine. Gravel after the cattle grid, bad for about 2km. Not a ride for road bikes in the wet
Would need to go via the old road instead. Will send a version
Ok. Send it. Gravel on the old road?
Old road is better. Patched last year
Old road has a blind bend near the quarry. Need a marshal at the bend
Noted
Amir, the January ride needs a rider count before we book the rest stop. Ask Chloe for the list
i can do a poll in the group. will post after my lecture tomorrow
Going to sleep soon. Zara send the new gpx when you have it
Tomorrow
